items.title: Vercel Container Registry now supports 2 GB compressed image layers
items.summary: now supports up to 2 GB per compressed image layer, up from 500 MB, allowing larger layers to be pushed without splitting them. The total image size limit remains 15 GB.Vercel Container RegistryThe higher layer limit is useful for images with large toolchains or dependency sets, such as custom  environments for coding-agent evaluations.Vercel SandboxWith Docker and the  installed, run these commands from the directory containing your Dockerfile:Vercel CLIRead the  to build, push, and pull your first container image.Vercel Container Registry getting-started guideRead more
